name: sms-cli
description: Agent-friendly SMS CLI for sending messages via Twilio, Vonage, MailerSend, Clickatell, or Telnyx. Structured JSON output, semantic exit codes, non-interactive by design.

install_steps: Build: cd sms-cli && bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile bin/sms-cli
install_guidance.note: Requires bun (bun.sh) to compile. Binary has no runtime dependencies.
